services.name: Charter Day
services.desc: , Bryn Athyn College of the New Church’s homecoming weekend, is held every October during a weekend filled with events. It is a celebration of the signing of the Charter in 1877, which founded Bryn Athyn College of the New Church, the Theological School, and our sister organization, The Academy of the New Church Secondary Schools (ANCSS). Every year, traditional festivities include alumni and friends events, pickup and spectator games, campus tours, worship services, and a golf outing. The weekend begins with a visually striking procession in which our students walk from the College’s Brickman Center to a community worship service in Bryn Athyn Cathedral, led by the country flags
